cohort: Pregnant women admitted for delivery at Gonzaga Mota of Messejana Hospital, Fortaleza, CE, Brazil, from June to August 2020.
finding: Universal screening of pregnant women admitted for delivery can reduce the perinatal transmission of COVID-19, with symptom-based screening serving as an alternative in low-prevalence regions where 14% of newborns from symptomatic mothers tested positive but none had serious complications at birth.
